body.statement: If \(f\), \(\theta'\), and \(\kappa\) are constant on \(J\), then \(T_n(P)=n^{1/3}|J|\{f\theta'^2/(4\kappa)\}^{1/3}\); once this deterministic horizon lies in \([T_0,\infty)\), Theorems 1--3 reduce to a stationary canonical LR maximum on that interval. At one fixed dose, the marginal statistic reduces to the Banerjee--Wellner law \(D(0)\).
body.justification: The reduction checks both the spatial factor and the fixed-point normalization against known theory.
body.gap: The fixed-dose reduction is known from Banerjee and Wellner (2001); the growing deterministic interval is the new simultaneous component.
body.consumer: It supplies an oracle simulation benchmark and a falsification check for implementations before applying heterogeneous clock estimation.
